points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable source CMake build exited 0 in network-disabled cfd-bench with configured external root; run 02 also uses its documented CFD_HEADER_ROOT. No host credentials or network exposed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Submitted run metadata and scripts record the required solve --case --output form; direct isolated invocation without a case exits nonzero with ERROR: --case is required. A full documented solve was not rerun because submitted results exist; standalone --help is rejected as missing case. Other malformed-input modes remain unverified.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt:28–37 separates configuration, reader, global/local mesh, partition, solver and output sources. Numerical physics remains largely concentrated in solver.cpp; documented reduced-slope and 2-D assumptions limit generalization.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt builds the submitted C++ source and links MPI/CGNS/METIS/HDF5/zlib; direct source inspection found no invocation of an external CFD executable. Per trust policy no authorship or external similarity search was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.cpp:70 resolves the supplied mesh path and :123–124 parses boundary configuration; solver accepts configuration rather than two hard-coded mesh filenames. General arbitrary mesh compatibility remains unverified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp:296 calls METIS; solver.cpp:231–249 and :329–349 exchange state and gradients with neighbors, :913–915 and :1110 reduce residuals/forces. Submitted np=1/2/4/8 short continuation histories agree within 1e-9 in Cd for a cylinder and a NACA case; report.tex:248–266 documents the shared-restart test and 4-CPU quota. It is not an independent full convergence comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:524–545 and :946–969 apply reconstructed-state and update positivity safeguards. Production uses a first-order fallback and reduced slopes for stability, disclosed in report.tex:554–567; malformed-input and resource-stress coverage remains incomplete.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: report.tex:268–287 describes uniform-field, linear-gradient and rank continuation checks; submitted eight result packages pass structural validation. Independent order-of-accuracy and full reruns were not performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clean build succeeds with warnings for an unused function; CMakeLists.txt builds separated source units. Curation excluded generated artifacts from the result tip; preserved earlier contestant history retains those blobs.
